text:
To be born to you again,

I want you to go ahead

of my steps over the earth,

which, though small, is very large.


Here you are accompanied

by my daily presence,

but orphaned of you

I would be, if you remained.


That is why I want you to walk,

little step by little step,

ahead and always ahead,

without hurry and without rest.


Thus, when I peer out

to the other side of here,

you will be prepared

to give birth to me again.

translation.title: To Be Born to You Again...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the reversal in which the beloved is asked to go first and rebirth the speaker.
